text:
Samira R.: opened a small PR to reorganize structured-output examples and unify SDK snippets to the new action-response shape: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5410. need quick sanity on JSON shapes + migration blurb.
Leo H.: looks light. which files are moving?
Samira R.: collapsing guides/structured-output/long_examples.md into examples/overflow/long_examples.md and leaving a compact canonical page at guides/structured-output/index.md. adding simple redirects on the old paths.
Gabe T.: paste of the canonical JSON snippet kept in index.md:
```json
{
  "action": "get_profile",
  "args": { "profile_id": "p_7" },
  "response": { "status": "ok", "payload": null }
}
```
Leo H.: quick note: add one sentence clarifying payload:null means "no data, not an error" (like HTTP 204). saves confusion.
Samira R.: good call, will add. also switching JS examples to client.callAction, Python to client.call_action. leaving an explicit one-liner that older SDKs may still use invoke/tool_call.
doc-ci: link-check: detected 4 broken anchors in guides/structured-output (CI job #3321).
Gabe T.: i can add anchor redirects and update internal links to /spec/structured-output. avoid deleting anchors to not break external links.
Samira R.: blocker: Hugo was trimming leading indentation from fenced blocks in the last build, so remove leading spaces on triple-backtick blocks.
Leo H.: running markdown-lint and a grep for "invoke(" to flag remaining snippets. will push fixes.
doc-ci: docs-build: preview https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-5410. link-check now 0 failures.
Samira R.: merged ":tada:" thanks everyone — i'll follow up with a short checklist doc for future spec changes (lint, link-check, SDK grep, redirects).
